summary: Tested RetailFlow AI backend (32 pytest cases) and frontend critical flows. Backend now passes 100% after I fixed an ObjectId serialization bug in POST /api/bills. Frontend landing page, login for all 3 roles with correct dashboard routing, business owner dashboard KPIs/charts, POS cart add+totals all working. Platform admin sees pending approvals UI with approve/reject buttons.

issues: Product cards show only first-letter placeholders (no image_url seeded). Acceptable but visually plain.

action_items: (FIXED by testing agent) POST /api/bills was returning 500 because motor's insert_one mutates the dict with ObjectId _id and FastAPI then failed to JSON-serialize. Added bill_doc.pop('_id', None) before return. Recommend a global cleanup helper for all insert-then-return patterns.
Optional: Verify front-end theme toggle persistence across pages (only visually inspected; html-class change not detected in automation - may be using a different mechanism).

Optional: Pending business currently CAN login (returns subscription_status='pending') - frontend handles via PendingApproval route. Spec said login should fail OR redirect; current behavior is 'login + redirect' which is acceptable.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_business.py is 743 lines - approaching the 700 line guideline; consider splitting into products/bills/inventory/po/expenses modules.
JWT_SECRET has default 'secret' in auth_utils.py fallback - acceptable since .env always provides one, but production should remove fallback.
Several endpoints manually pop _id instead of using clean_doc helper - inconsistent pattern (e.g., list_products, list_inventory_txns, list_pos, list_expenses).
Bill creation does not check stock availability before deducting - can produce negative stock.
create_customer returns existing customer doc on duplicate phone but returns {id} on new creation - inconsistent response shape.
Reports endpoint /api/reports/<type> exists and works (verified) but not seen in detail review.
updated_files: /app/backend/routes_business.py (1-line fix: pop _id before returning bill_doc in POST /api/bills)
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md - all 4 demo accounts authenticate successfully.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed businesses/products/customers/suppliers/POs on each run. No teardown done; harmless data with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, RBAC, platform admin approve flow, products/customers/bills CRUD, inventory, PO->expense, expense approval, dashboard, reports, and tenant isolation. Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v. The ObjectId-in-response bug was fixed in routes_business.py line ~408. Frontend was verified manually via browser automation for login routing for 3 roles + POS cart flow. POS UI uses [data-testid] sparsely; for deeper automation, ask main agent to add more data-testid attrs (product cards, cart items, pay button).
rca of the issue: POST /api/bills returned 500. RCA: db.bills.insert_one(bill_doc) mutates bill_doc in-place adding _id: ObjectId. Endpoint then returned bill_doc directly; FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize bson.ObjectId, raising 'ObjectId is not iterable'. Mitigation: pop '_id' from the dict before returning (now applied). Long-term: use the existing clean_doc helper or copy doc before insert.
